title: Barcelona city tour and Sagrada Família tour
text: Baggio was very well versed in the history of Barcelona. He was able to modify our tour to accommodate mobility issues for one person in our group.  He really impressed us with his knowledge of both religious and political histories of Barcelona. It made the tour very worthwhile. We give him five stars! Anyone who takes his tour will be glad they did.
author: Tomcp

title: Great Fun Day! Great guide!
text: We had a wonderful time spending the day with our guide, Steven. Very professional, very knowledgeable and lot of fun. We learned a lot and got a great tour of Barcelona!
author: Jay_K

title: Super Fun Day in Barcelona
text: Steven did such a great job taking us around Barcelona, sharing historical information and great stories. He was just very knowledgeable and made it fun and interesting. and we even got to stop and have a coffee ...  which we really needed:)  So grateful for all the things we got to see. Thanks again Steven!
author: jaynsuzy

title: Every Nook and Cranny in Barcelona with Adele!
text: Knowing nothing about Barcelona and little time, we booked a private tour.  Jackpot!  Adele met us near our cruise ship and off we went.  Holding a conversation as we walked we saw things up close and why we were seeing it.  Things few others saw. We hit many major places like Sagrada Familia, but also in the alleys where artists and history coexisted.  I am now a big St. George fan!  In one alley, artists showed their work.  I now have a handmade dragon, fantastic unique work of art.  Nothing compared to Gaudi's houses and buildings.  We saw these up-close too.  Adele filled in all the blanks
author: Ronald_H

title: Do this tour of Barcelona!!
text: Such a great tour, Joris is so knowledgeable and personable. He gave us great descriptions of every place we visited and has ready answers for our inquires for additional details on every stop. Feel like we know Barcelona now. Do it!!
author: michaelmU199FQ

title: Great way to see Sagrada Família and the Gothhic Quarter on 5 hours
text:
Great 5 hour tour of Barcelona Gothic Quarter and Sagrada Família  with Joris.  He was extremely knowledgeable and kept the pace well suited for us. 

The Sagrada Família app was frustrating - it would stop for no reason and then restart from the beginning of that particular stop.
author: glennj661

title: Barcelona day trip with David
text:
We had an amazing private tour with David yesterday. He went above and beyond throughout the day to accommodate our group. He was extremely knowledgeable, personable and we were able to learn and see so much in Barcelona. We all definitely highly recommend this tour; especially with David!  
And he even took us to find a Harley Davidson shop in Barcelona!!!   Holy Moly!!
author: susiem34

title: Wonderful guide and tour highly recommended
text: Baggio was excellent and the Barcelona tour is everything you need to see.  Our tour guide Baggio  was very knowledgeable and very experienced.   I would highly recommend thus tour 5 Stars
author: Dennis Roland D

title: Great day!
text: It was a great exposure to the history and city. Liana was knowledgeable and a real pleasure to be with. We would recommend this tour and her as your guide.
author: Sharon_J

title: Fantastic personal tour
text: Mario our guide was exceptional extremely informative and had a great knowledge of the area. He was warm and personable would book again and ask for Mario. We would highly recommend him , he is also a great singer
